text: Calm-Down Box: paper, pens, stress ball, soothing pictures. When he gets angry, go to him together, choose a tool, and discuss after 10 minutes.

review_defects.why: The Arabic uses the singular imperative 'اختر' (addressing the child), while the English 'choose' is ambiguous and could be interpreted as a command to the parents. This changes who is instructed to pick the tool.
